a: Property-based tests check invariants across many generated inputs.
Mutation testing evaluates whether tests catch intentional code faults.
Flaky tests pass/fail nondeterministically; quarantine and fix.
Builders create readable, flexible test fixtures.
Hermetic tests avoid external network and shared mutable state.
Golden-file tests compare output to a stored expected file.
Chaos testing injects failures to verify resilience.
Canary analysis compares metrics between old and new versions.
a11y tests check keyboard use, labels, and contrast basics.
Performance budgets set limits on size and timing metrics.
